import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
OUT="/agent/jobs/2b70b38c-2ea5-4319-89cb-da475f3f6965/provenance"
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
POS=set("KR"); NEG=set("DE")

def usearch(q,cap=1600,fields="accession,organism_name,ft_signal,ft_transmem,sequence"):
    out=[];r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"tsv","fields":fields},timeout=180)
    while True:
        L=r.text.rstrip("\n").split("\n");hdr=L[0].split("\t");out+=[l.split("\t") for l in L[1:]]
        nx=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nx or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=requests.get(nx,timeout=180)
    return pd.DataFrame(out[:cap],columns=hdr)

def feats(seq,win=19,scan=70):
    s=seq[:scan];kd=np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in s]);best=(0,-99)
    for i in range(0,len(s)-win+1):
        m=kd[i:i+win].mean()
        if m>best[1]: best=(i,m)
    i0,hmax=best;c=i0+win//2;L=c
    while L>0 and (kd[L-1]>0 or (L-2>=0 and kd[L-2]>0)): L-=1
    n=s[:L]
    return len(n), sum(ch in POS for ch in n)-sum(ch in NEG for ch in n)

spdf=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_signal_exp:*) AND (length:[150 TO 900])')
fun=usearch('(taxonomy_id:4751) AND (ft_signal:*) AND (reviewed:true) AND (length:[150 TO 900])')
exp_nc=np.array([feats(s)[1] for s in spdf["Sequence"]])
fun_nc=np.array([feats(s)[1] for s in fun["Sequence"]])
print("=== How unusual is an n-region net charge of +5 among PROVEN signal peptides? ===")
for name,arr in [("experimental eukaryotic SPs",exp_nc),("reviewed fungal SPs",fun_nc)]:
    print(f"{name}: n={len(arr)}  mean {arr.mean():.2f}  median {np.median(arr):.0f}  "
          f"fraction >= +3: {(arr>=3).mean():.1%}   >= +5: {(arr>=5).mean():.1%}   >= +6: {(arr>=6).mean():.1%}")
ex=[(a,o) for a,o,s in zip(spdf["Entry"],spdf["Organism"],spdf["Sequence"]) if feats(s)[1]>=5]

P=61.6

      strength=f"moderate, LR {LR_af:.1f}:1", basis="44 vs 43 controls, AUC 0.915, p=1.4e-11"),

      strength="weak", basis=f"{(exp_nc>=5).mean():.1%} of experimentally validated SPs also reach +5; Kar2-like"),

]

names=["AlphaFold\npLDDT","h-core\ncomposition","cleavage\nPWM","n-region\ncharge"]
pomb=[1,0,0,0]
ax[1].axis("off")
txt=("Discrimination quality of each metric\n(out-of-sample, on held-out controls)\n\n"
